mapper.select: SELECT ci.ct_id_pk, ci.ct_name, ci.ct_phone, ci.ct_how_many, do.do_name, do.do_price, mp.mp_explain, mp.mp_charge, GROUP_CONCAT(po.po_name SEPARATOR ', ') AS option_names, GROUP_CONCAT(po.po_extra_price SEPARATOR ', ') AS option_prices, MIN(cco.oc_created_at) AS created_at, (ci.ct_how_many * mp.mp_charge + SUM(po.po_extra_price) + do.do_price) AS total_price FROM customer_info ci INNER JOIN main_product mp ON mp.mp_id_pk = ci.ct_type INNER JOIN delivery_option do ON do.do_id_pk = ci.ct_delivery_op INNER JOIN customer_choice_option cco ON cco.ct_id_pk = ci.ct_id_pk INNER JOIN product_option po ON po.po_id_pk = cco.po_id_pk WHERE ci.ct_id_pk = #{ct_id_pk} GROUP BY ci.ct_id_pk, ci.ct_name, ci.ct_phone, ci.ct_how_many, do.do_name, do.do_price, mp.mp_explain, mp.mp_charge;
